subtasks.description: Verify PostgreSQL is accessible and accepting connections

subtasks.description: Verify Redis is accessible and responding to ping
subtasks.notes: SANDBOX RESTRICTION: Docker commands not available in Claude Code sandbox. phases.name: Database Schema Validation
phases.description: Generate Prisma client and push schema to local PostgreSQL database

subtasks.notes: SANDBOX RESTRICTION: pnpm/npx commands not available in Claude Code sandbox. ANALYSIS COMPLETED: (1) Verified Prisma schema at packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma - comprehensive 2215-line schema with 50+ models including User, Organization, Brand, BrandBrain, VoiceAgent, CallLog, ContentItem, etc. (2) Generator configuration uses 'prisma-client-js' with binaryTargets ['native', 'rhel-openssl-3.0.x'] for cross-platform support. (4) package.json scripts confirm: 'generate' runs 'prisma generate', 'postinstall' also runs 'prisma generate' (auto-generates on npm/pnpm install). (5) Root package.json defines 'db:generate' as 'pnpm --filter @epic-ai/database generate'. MANUAL VERIFICATION: Run 'pnpm db:generate' from project root - expected output: 'Generated Prisma Client (v6.x.x) to ./node_modules/@prisma/client in XXms'. The generated client provides type-safe database access for all 50+ models. NOTE: If dependencies are installed via 'pnpm install', Prisma client is auto-generated via postinstall hook.

subtasks.notes:

**Verification Command Options:**
1. Browser: Open http://localhost:3000 in any modern browser

3. PowerShell: `(Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3000 -UseBasicParsing).StatusCode`

**Expected Behavior at localhost:3000:**

FOR UNAUTHENTICATED USERS:
- HTTP Status: 200 OK
- Page Title: "Epic AI - AI Marketing Platform"
- Content: LandingHero component renders with:
  - Navigation: "Epic AI" logo + Sign In/Get Started buttons
  - Hero: "AI Marketing Engine - From Social to Sale"
  - Features: 3 cards (Social Media, Voice AI Agents, The Flywheel)
  - Footer: © 2025 Epic AI

FOR AUTHENTICATED USERS:
- HTTP Status: 307 Temporary Redirect
- Location: /dashboard
- No page content rendered (redirect occurs server-side)

**Application Stack (verified via code analysis):**
- RootLayout: ClerkProvider wrapping entire app
- Providers: PostHogProvider > NextThemesProvider > HeroUIProvider
- Error Boundary: error.tsx handles runtime errors gracefully
- Styles: Tailwind CSS with dark mode support

**Browser Console Verification:**
- [ ] No "CLERK_SECRET_KEY" errors (requires valid env vars)
- [ ] No "Failed to fetch" errors
- [ ] No React hydration mismatch warnings
- [ ] No 500/404 errors in Network tab

**Page Routes to Verify:**
| URL | Expected |
|-----|----------|
| http://localhost:3000 | Landing page (unauth) or redirect to /dashboard (auth) |
| http://localhost:3000/sign-in | Clerk sign-in page with Epic AI branding |
| http://localhost:3000/sign-up | Clerk sign-up page |
| http://localhost:3000/dashboard | Dashboard (auth required) or redirect to /sign-in |

1. Dev server running: `pnpm dev` shows "Ready in X ms"
2. PostgreSQL container healthy (for Prisma operations)

- ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED: Dev server not running - start with `pnpm dev`
